candidates.change_summary: Replace the body of withdrawAll to call super.withdrawAll instead of withdraw with the contract balance.
Replace `payable(msg.sender).transfer(_value)` with `payable(msg.sender).transfer(0)` to make withdraw send no ether.
Change `transfer(_value)` to `call{value: 0}("")` so that the function does not transfer any ether.
Replace `payable(msg.sender).transfer(_value)` with a selfdestruct that transfers entire balance to owner.
Add a statement at the beginning to revert if _value == 0, blocking withdrawals of zero value.
Delete the entire sendMoney function body so it does nothing.
